## Standing operator rules
Run procedure “Python library release 2.8.0” between other work, executing all nine listed steps in order, one at a time. Always run `make license-check` from the repository root after changing `requirements/base.txt`. Paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing. Never create a service-specific Google Cloud NAT gateway for ledgerly; use `ledgerly-shared-prod-nat`.

## Current objective
Resume release 2.8.0 at step 4. Vendor-credit import and SQLAlchemy upgrade are paused/superseded.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Redis: `REDIS_URL=redis://cache-eu-3:6379`; `cache-eu-1` is superseded. `CHUNK_SIZE = 100`; `ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8)`. CSV uses `encoding="utf-8"`. `build_invoice_lines()` returns `list(_iter_line_items(...))`.

## Ruled-out approaches
SQLAlchemy pool size 50 caused staging lock contention and deadlocks.

## Plan and progress
Release steps 1–3 done; steps 4–9 pending; step-4 command is not recorded. Next pending: `mypy ledgerly/billing/invoices.py`; status unknown.

## Recent work
Optimized test setup with factories, session rollback, batch customers, and a frozen clock. Report tests passed 28/28. Invoice credit application still needs investigation: credit was applied before refund deduction, yielding `90.00` instead of `87.50`.
